clue.text: Almost barking, dog's first to break cover

clue.text: The greatest lover of all in Le Tour?

clue.text: Sommelier's slur being ignored

clue.text: Final phase, in which top mark is obtained

clue.text: Sweet way to turn one on!

clue.text: Defence given by ol' prince, closet racist?

clue.text: Soaks stare at us, when in a state
